p, k = map(int, input().split())

MAXN = 1000005
vis = [False] * MAXN
MOD = 1000000007

def dfs(i):
    if not vis[i]:
        vis[i] = True
        dfs((k * i) % p)

ans = 1
for i in range(1, p):
    if not vis[i]:
        dfs(i)
        ans = (ans * p) % MOD

if k == 1:
    ans = (ans * p) % MOD

print(ans)
